test_cases.description: MountHandlers registers all four git smart HTTP routes on the Echo instance at startup.
preconditions: Echo HTTP server instance is initialized
git server module MountHandlers function is available
test_cases.input: Call MountHandlers(e) on a fresh Echo instance
test_cases.expected: Echo router has routes: GET /git/:org/:slug.git/info/refs, POST /git/:org/:slug.git/git-upload-pack, POST /git/:org/:slug.git/git-receive-pack, all with auth middleware applied
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: e = echo.New(); MountHandlers(e); routes = e.Routes(); assert routes contains GET '/git/:org/:slug.git/info/refs'; assert routes contains POST '/git/:org/:slug.git/git-upload-pack'; assert routes contains POST '/git/:org/:slug.git/git-receive-pack'; assert each route has auth middleware in its middleware chain

test_cases.description: GET info/refs with service=git-upload-pack returns HTTP 200 with the correct Content-Type and a pkt-line ref advertisement body.
preconditions: Workspace exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
Request is authenticated with a valid credential having git:read scope
Org slug matches workspace org_id
test_cases.input: GET /git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack with valid Authorization: Basic header
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200, Content-Type: application/x-git-upload-pack-advertisement, body is a valid pkt-line encoded ref advertisement starting with the service line '# service=git-upload-pack'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': basicAuth}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-upload-pack-advertisement'; assert resp.body starts with pktLine('# service=git-upload-pack\n'); assert resp.body contains flush packet (0000)

test_cases.description: GET info/refs with service=git-receive-pack returns HTTP 200 with the correct Content-Type and a pkt-line ref advertisement body.
preconditions: Workspace exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
Request is authenticated with a valid credential having git:write scope
Org slug matches workspace org_id
test_cases.input: GET /git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git/info/refs?service=git-receive-pack with valid Authorization: Basic header
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200, Content-Type: application/x-git-receive-pack-advertisement, body is a valid pkt-line encoded ref advertisement starting with '# service=git-receive-pack'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-receive-pack', headers={'Authorization': basicAuth}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-receive-pack-advertisement'; assert resp.body starts with pktLine('# service=git-receive-pack\n'); assert resp.body contains flush packet (0000)

test_cases.description: POST to git-upload-pack returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/x-git-upload-pack-result and a streaming pack response.
preconditions: Workspace exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ with at least one commit
Request is authenticated with a valid credential having git:read scope
Org slug matches workspace org_id
test_cases.input: POST /git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git/git-upload-pack with valid Authorization: Basic header and a valid git upload-pack request body (want lines + flush)
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200, Content-Type: application/x-git-upload-pack-result, body contains a valid git pack stream
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: body = buildUploadPackRequest(wantSHA); resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack', body=body, headers={'Authorization': basicAuth, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-git-upload-pack-request'}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-upload-pack-result'; assert resp.body contains PACK signature bytes

test_cases.description: POST to git-receive-pack returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/x-git-receive-pack-result and a streaming pack response.
preconditions: Workspace exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
Request is authenticated with a valid credential having git:write scope
Org slug matches workspace org_id
test_cases.input: POST /git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git/git-receive-pack with valid Authorization: Basic header and a valid git receive-pack request body
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200, Content-Type: application/x-git-receive-pack-result, body contains a valid git receive-pack result stream with unpack ok
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: body = buildReceivePackRequest(oldSHA, newSHA, packData); resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack', body=body, headers={'Authorization': basicAuth, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-git-receive-pack-request'}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-receive-pack-result'; assert resp.body contains pktLine('unpack ok\n')

test_cases.description: A request with a valid af_pat_ credential in the Basic auth password field is resolved to the PAT identity and passed to the next handler; the username field is ignored.
preconditions: A PAT with token 'af_pat_abc123' exists in the database with git:read scope
apikit credential resolution is configured
test_cases.expected: Auth middleware resolves the PAT identity and attaches it to the request context; the next handler is called; no 401 or 403 is returned at the auth stage
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: nextCalled = false; middleware = gitAuthMiddleware(next=func(ctx){ nextCalled=true }); req = newRequest('GET', '/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + base64('anyusername:af_pat_abc123')}); middleware(req); assert nextCalled == true; assert ctx.identity != nil; assert ctx.identity.type == 'pat'

test_cases.description: A git request with no Authorization header receives HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm='af-hub' and no body.
preconditions: Git auth middleware is configured on the route
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401, header WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="af-hub", empty response body
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack'); assert resp.status == 401; assert resp.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] == 'Basic realm="af-hub"'; assert resp.body == ''

test_cases.description: A git request with an unrecognized credential in the Basic auth password field returns HTTP 401 without a WWW-Authenticate header.
preconditions: Git auth middleware is configured
The credential 'af_key_invalid999' does not exist in the database
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401, no WWW-Authenticate header in the response
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + base64('user:af_key_invalid999')}); assert resp.status == 401; assert resp.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] == nil

test_cases.description: Git server initialization registers git:read and git:write as named apikit.Permission scopes.

test_cases.expected: apikit permission registry contains both 'git:read' and 'git:write' as registered permissions
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: initGitServer(); perms = apikit.RegisteredPermissions(); assert perms contains 'git:read'; assert perms contains 'git:write'

test_cases.description: A PAT with only git:write scope is permitted to perform both fetch and push operations.

PAT 'af_pat_writeonly' exists with git:write scope only, belonging to user A
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
test_cases.input: First: GET /git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack with af_pat_writeonly; Second: GET /git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-receive-pack with af_pat_writeonly

test_cases.description: A PAT with git:read scope but no workspaces:read scope can still perform git fetch operations.

test_cases.description: Repository resolver extracts org and slug from the URL, verifies org_id, verifies clone_status=ready, opens the repository via PlainOpen, and returns the storer to the transport.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', org_id matching org 'myorg'
Directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/ exists and is a valid git repository
Authenticated identity is the workspace owner
test_cases.expected: Loader.Load() is called with endpoint path '/myorg/myws.git', returns (storer.Storer, nil); HTTP 200 is returned to the client
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: loader = newWorkspaceLoader(db, workspaceRoot); ep = parseEndpoint('http://hub/git/myorg/myws.git'); storer, err = loader.Load(ep); assert err == nil; assert storer != nil

test_cases.description: Repository resolver returns transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound and HTTP 404 when no workspace with the given slug exists.
preconditions: No workspace with slug 'nonexistent' exists in the database
Authenticated identity is a valid user
test_cases.expected: Loader.Load() returns (nil, transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound); HTTP handler returns HTTP 404 with a pkt-line error body
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: loader = newWorkspaceLoader(db, workspaceRoot); ep = parseEndpoint('http://hub/git/myorg/nonexistent.git'); storer, err = loader.Load(ep); assert err == transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound; assert storer == nil; resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/nonexistent.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 404

test_cases.description: Repository resolver returns transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound and HTTP 404 when the workspace clone_status is not 'ready'.

test_cases.description: A valid info/refs GET request causes the handler to create a session, call AdvertisedReferences(), encode the result as pkt-line, and write it to the HTTP response with the correct Content-Type.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/ with at least one ref
Authenticated identity has git:read scope and owns the workspace
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200, Content-Type: application/x-git-upload-pack-advertisement, body is a well-formed pkt-line ref advertisement with capability flush (0000)
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-upload-pack-advertisement'; body = resp.body; assert parsePktLine(body) contains service line and at least one ref line; assert body ends with flush packet

test_cases.description: A valid POST to git-upload-pack or git-receive-pack streams the request body to the session and streams the session output back as the HTTP response body.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/ with commits
Authenticated identity has git:read scope and owns the workspace
test_cases.input: POST /git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack with a valid upload-pack negotiation body
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200, Content-Type: application/x-git-upload-pack-result, body is a streaming pack response containing PACK data
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: body = buildUploadPackNegotiation(wantSHA); resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack', body=body, headers={auth, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-git-upload-pack-request'}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-upload-pack-result'; assert resp.body contains PACK magic bytes (0x5041434b)

test_cases.description: When the go-git session returns an error during streaming, the handler encodes the error in pkt-line ERR format and writes it to the response body if headers have not yet been sent.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
go-git session is mocked to return an error immediately
Authenticated identity has git:read scope and owns the workspace
test_cases.input: POST /git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack with a request body that triggers a session error
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with a pkt-line body containing 'ERR <message>' where message describes the session error
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mockSession = sessionThatErrors('pack negotiation failed'); resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack', body=validBody, headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body contains pktLine('ERR pack negotiation failed\n')

property_tests.description: For any workspace with clone_status not equal to 'ready', all four git endpoints return HTTP 404 and never open the repository filesystem.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample workspaces with clone_status in {'cloning', 'failed', 'archived', 'pending'} by inserting rows with each status into the test database; for each status, send requests to all four git endpoints (GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack, GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack, POST git-upload-pack, POST git-receive-pack) with a valid owner credential
property_tests.invariant_check: for each (status, endpoint) pair: assert resp.status == 404; assert PlainOpen was never called (verified via mock/spy on PlainOpen); assert no file handle was opened under <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/

property_tests.description: For any git request with no Authorization header, the response is always HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm='af-hub' and the repository is never accessed.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random valid workspace slugs and org slugs (existing and non-existing); for each combination, send all four git endpoint requests with no Authorization header
property_tests.invariant_check: for each request: assert resp.status == 401; assert resp.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] == 'Basic realm="af-hub"'; assert Loader.Load was never called (verified via mock/spy)

property_tests.description: For any authenticated request where the credential owner is not the workspace owner and not an admin, the response is always HTTP 404 regardless of whether the workspace exists.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate pairs of (workspace, credential) where the credential belongs to a different user than the workspace owner; include cases where the workspace exists and where it does not; use API keys and PATs with various git scopes
property_tests.invariant_check: for each (workspace, credential) pair: assert resp.status == 404; assert resp.status != 403; assert resp.body does not reveal workspace existence

property_tests.description: For any PAT with git:write scope and no explicit git:read scope, both fetch/clone and push operations are permitted on workspaces the PAT owner owns.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate PATs with only git:write scope (no git:read) belonging to workspace owners; for each PAT, attempt both GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack and GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack against owned workspaces with clone_status='ready'
property_tests.invariant_check: for each PAT: fetchResp.status == 200; pushResp.status == 200; neither request is rejected with 403

property_tests.description: After every successful ReceivePackSession completion, the head_sha column in the database equals the SHA of the HEAD commit in the local clone.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate a sequence of N valid pushes (N between 1 and 10) to the same workspace, each adding one or more commits; after each push, read both the database head_sha and the actual HEAD SHA from the local repository
property_tests.invariant_check: after each successful push: dbHeadSHA = db.queryWorkspace(slug).head_sha; repoHeadSHA = git.PlainOpen('<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/').Head().Hash().String(); assert dbHeadSHA == repoHeadSHA; assert len(dbHeadSHA) == 40

property_tests.description: For any request where the org-slug in the URL does not match the org_id of the workspace identified by workspace-slug, the response is always HTTP 404.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate pairs of (workspace, org-slug) where the org-slug is a valid org slug but does not match the workspace's org_id; include cases where the org-slug belongs to a different existing org and cases where it does not exist at all; use valid owner credentials
property_tests.invariant_check: for each (workspace, wrong-org-slug) pair: assert resp.status == 404; assert resp.status != 200; assert resp.status != 403

property_tests.description: For any successful response from any of the four git endpoints, the Content-Type header exactly matches the git smart HTTP specification for that endpoint.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate valid requests for all four endpoints (info/refs?service=git-upload-pack, info/refs?service=git-receive-pack, POST git-upload-pack, POST git-receive-pack) across multiple workspaces with clone_status='ready' and valid owner credentials
property_tests.invariant_check: for GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack: assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-upload-pack-advertisement'; for GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack: assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-receive-pack-advertisement'; for POST git-upload-pack: assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-upload-pack-result'; for POST git-receive-pack: assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/x-git-receive-pack-result'

edge_case_tests.description: A malformed Authorization header (not valid Base64 or missing colon separator) returns HTTP 401.
preconditions: Git auth middleware is configured on the route
edge_case_tests.input: GET /git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack with Authorization: Basic !!!notbase64!!! and Authorization: Basic dXNlcg== (base64 of 'user' with no colon)
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 401 for both malformed cases
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp1 = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic !!!notbase64!!!'}); assert resp1.status == 401; resp2 = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + base64('usernocodon')}); assert resp2.status == 401

edge_case_tests.description: Any non-empty string in the username field of HTTP Basic auth is accepted; only the password field is used for credential resolution.
preconditions: PAT 'af_pat_valid' exists with git:read scope, belonging to user A
Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', owned by user A
edge_case_tests.input: GET /git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack with Authorization: Basic base64('randomusername:af_pat_valid') and with base64('x-token-auth:af_pat_valid') and with base64('anything:af_pat_valid')
edge_case_tests.expected: All three requests return HTTP 200; the username field does not affect authentication outcome
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: for username in ['randomusername', 'x-token-auth', 'anything']: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + base64(username + ':af_pat_valid')}); assert resp.status == 200

edge_case_tests.description: A PAT with git:read scope attempting a push (POST to git-receive-pack) is rejected with HTTP 403.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', owned by user A
PAT 'af_pat_readonly' exists with git:read scope only, belonging to user A
edge_case_tests.input: POST /git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack with Authorization: Basic base64('x:af_pat_readonly') and a valid pack body
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 403; no data is written to the repository
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack', body=packData, headers={'Authorization': basicAuth('x', 'af_pat_readonly')}); assert resp.status == 403

edge_case_tests.description: A PAT with neither git:read nor git:write scope attempting any git operation is rejected with HTTP 403.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', owned by user A
PAT 'af_pat_noscope' exists with workspaces:read scope only (no git scopes), belonging to user A
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 403; the request is rejected at the authorization middleware
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': basicAuth('x', 'af_pat_noscope')}); assert resp.status == 403

edge_case_tests.description: When PlainOpen fails due to a filesystem error, the handler logs the error and returns HTTP 500.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', org_id matching 'myorg'
Directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/ does not exist or has permission denied
Authenticated identity is the workspace owner with git:read scope
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 500; error is logged; no repository data is returned to the client
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: removeDir('<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/'); resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 500; assert logContains('PlainOpen error') or logContains('filesystem error')

edge_case_tests.description: An authenticated user who is not the workspace owner and not an admin receives HTTP 404 (anti-enumeration) for any git operation.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', owned by user A
API key 'af_key_userB' belongs to user B (not the owner, not an admin)
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 404; the response does not reveal whether the workspace exists
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': basicAuth('userB', 'af_key_userB')}); assert resp.status == 404

edge_case_tests.description: When the database query for the workspace times out or returns an unexpected error, the handler returns HTTP 500 without exposing database error details.
preconditions: Database is configured to simulate a timeout or unexpected error for workspace queries
Authenticated identity is a valid user
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 500; response body does not contain database error details (no SQL error messages, no stack traces)
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mockDB = dbThatTimesOut(); loader = newWorkspaceLoader(mockDB, workspaceRoot); resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 500; assert resp.body does not contain 'sql' or 'database' or 'timeout' in detail

edge_case_tests.description: A valid PAT with git:read scope belonging to a non-owner non-admin user receives HTTP 404 for any git operation (anti-enumeration).
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', owned by user A
PAT 'af_pat_userB_read' exists with git:read scope, belonging to user B (not owner, not admin)
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 404; the response does not reveal whether the workspace exists
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': basicAuth('x', 'af_pat_userB_read')}); assert resp.status == 404

edge_case_tests.description: A valid API key belonging to a non-owner non-admin user receives HTTP 404 for any git operation (anti-enumeration).
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', owned by user A
API key 'af_key_userC' belongs to user C (not owner, not admin)
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 404; the response does not reveal whether the workspace exists
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.get('/git/myorg/myws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', headers={'Authorization': basicAuth('userC', 'af_key_userC')}); assert resp.status == 404

edge_case_tests.description: When the database update of head_sha fails after a successful push, the git client receives a successful push response and the error is logged.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/
Database is configured to fail on UPDATE of head_sha
Authenticated identity is the workspace owner with git:write scope
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 200 with unpack ok in the response body; error about head_sha update failure is logged; the pack data is written to the local clone
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mockDB = dbThatFailsOnUpdate('head_sha'); resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack', body=packData, headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body contains pktLine('unpack ok\n'); assert logContains('head_sha update failed')

edge_case_tests.description: When reading the new HEAD SHA from the repository after a push fails, the error is logged and the push response is still successful.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/ in a state where HEAD resolution fails (e.g., detached HEAD)
Authenticated identity is the workspace owner with git:write scope
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 200 with unpack ok; head_sha is not updated in the database; error is logged
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mockRepo = repoWithDetachedHEAD(); resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack', body=packData, headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body contains pktLine('unpack ok\n'); assert logContains('HEAD SHA read error'); ws = db.queryWorkspace('myws'); assert ws.head_sha == originalSHA

edge_case_tests.description: When the ReceivePackSession itself fails (corrupt pack), head_sha is not updated and a pkt-line error is returned to the git client.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready', head_sha='originalsha'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/
Authenticated identity is the workspace owner with git:write scope
edge_case_tests.input: POST /git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack with a corrupt/truncated pack body
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 200 with a pkt-line ERR body; head_sha in the database remains 'originalsha'
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack', body=corruptPackData, headers={auth}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body contains pktLine('ERR '); ws = db.queryWorkspace('myws'); assert ws.head_sha == 'originalsha'

edge_case_tests.description: Two concurrent push requests for the same workspace are serialized; at most one succeeds atomically and the other receives a pkt-line error response.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/
Two authenticated identities (or same identity) both have git:write scope
edge_case_tests.input: Two simultaneous POST /git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack requests with different pack data
edge_case_tests.expected: Exactly one push succeeds (HTTP 200 with unpack ok); the other either succeeds sequentially or receives a pkt-line error; head_sha reflects exactly one of the two pushes; no data corruption occurs
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: results = concurrentRequests(2, func(){ return httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-receive-pack', body=packData, headers={auth}) }); successCount = count(r for r in results if r.body contains 'unpack ok'); assert successCount >= 1; assert successCount <= 2; ws = db.queryWorkspace('myws'); assert ws.head_sha is a valid SHA

edge_case_tests.description: When PlainOpen returns an I/O error (not repository-not-found), the Loader returns a wrapped error (not transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound) so the HTTP handler can return HTTP 500.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/ exists but has a permission error causing PlainOpen to fail with an I/O error
edge_case_tests.input: loader.Load(endpoint) where endpoint.Path = '/git/myorg/myws.git' and PlainOpen returns an I/O error
edge_case_tests.expected: Returns (nil, wrappedErr) where wrappedErr is not transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound; HTTP handler maps this to HTTP 500
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mockPlainOpen = func(path){ return nil, errors.New('permission denied') }; loader = newWorkspaceLoaderWithPlainOpen(db, workspaceRoot, mockPlainOpen); ep = &transport.Endpoint{Path: '/git/myorg/myws.git'}; s, err = loader.Load(ep); assert err != nil; assert err != transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound; assert s == nil

edge_case_tests.description: When the endpoint path does not contain a recognizable workspace-slug segment, the Loader returns transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound.
preconditions: Loader is initialized with a valid database and workspace root
edge_case_tests.expected: Returns (nil, transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound)
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: loader = newWorkspaceLoader(db, workspaceRoot); ep = &transport.Endpoint{Path: '/git/'}; s, err = loader.Load(ep); assert err == transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound; assert s == nil

edge_case_tests.description: When the git client disconnects mid-stream, the handler aborts the session, releases all resources, and logs the disconnection without leaving partial state.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/
Authenticated identity has git:read scope and owns the workspace
edge_case_tests.input: POST /git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack where the client closes the connection after sending partial data
edge_case_tests.expected: No response is sent; session is aborted; all file handles and session resources are released; error is logged; no partial state is left in the repository
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: conn = openConnection('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack', headers={auth}); conn.writePartialData(partialPack); conn.close(); waitForHandlerCompletion(); assert openFileHandles() == 0; assert logContains('client disconnected'); assert repoIntegrity('<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/') == true

edge_case_tests.description: When the go-git session hangs, a request-scoped context deadline cancels the session and closes the connection after the timeout elapses.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
go-git session is mocked to block indefinitely
Request timeout is configured to 100ms for testing
Authenticated identity has git:read scope and owns the workspace
edge_case_tests.input: POST /git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack where the session never returns
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP connection is closed after the timeout; session context is cancelled; resources are released; the handler does not block indefinitely
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mockSession = sessionThatBlocks(); start = now(); resp = httpClient.postWithTimeout('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack', body=validBody, headers={auth}, timeout=500ms); elapsed = now() - start; assert elapsed < 500ms; assert resp is connection closed or timeout error; assert sessionContextCancelled == true

edge_case_tests.description: When the request body for a POST pack operation is empty or truncated, the go-git session returns an error encoded as a pkt-line ERR response.
preconditions: Workspace 'myws' exists in database with clone_status='ready'
Local repository exists at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/myws/trunk/
Authenticated identity has git:read scope and owns the workspace
edge_case_tests.expected: HTTP 200 with a pkt-line ERR <message> body
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = httpClient.post('/git/myorg/myws.git/git-upload-pack', body='', headers={auth, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-git-upload-pack-request'}); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body contains pktLine('ERR ')

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end git clone happy path: a developer clones a workspace repository using a PAT with git:read scope via the smart HTTP protocol.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `git clone http://x-token-auth:<af_pat_readpat>@<hub-host>:<port>/git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git` against a running hub instance
real_components: Echo HTTP server with git routes registered via MountHandlers
git auth middleware (credential resolution via apikit)
git authorization middleware (scope and ownership check)
git server repository resolver (database lookup, org_id verification, clone_status check)
custom server.Loader (PlainOpen, storer.Storer resolution)
go-git server transport (UploadPackSession, AdvertisedReferences)
git HTTP handler (pkt-line encoding, streaming)
SQLite database (workspace table with clone_status, org_id)
local filesystem at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
mockable: upstream git remote (not accessed during clone from hub)
expected_effects: POST /git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git/git-upload-pack returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/x-git-upload-pack-result
git clone completes successfully and creates a local directory with the repository contents
The cloned repository contains the same commits as the workspace's local clone at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end git push happy path: a developer pushes commits to a workspace repository using a PAT with git:write scope, and head_sha is updated in the database.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `git push` from a local clone of the workspace repository against a running hub instance using a PAT with git:write scope
real_components: Echo HTTP server with git routes registered via MountHandlers
git auth middleware (credential resolution via apikit)
git authorization middleware (scope and ownership check)
git server repository resolver (database lookup, org_id verification, clone_status check)
custom server.Loader (PlainOpen, storer.Storer resolution)
go-git server transport (ReceivePackSession)
git HTTP handler (pkt-line encoding, streaming)
git server push handler (head_sha update)
SQLite database (workspace table with head_sha column)
local filesystem at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
mockable: upstream git remote (not accessed during push to hub)
expected_effects: POST /git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git/git-receive-pack returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/x-git-receive-pack-result
git push completes successfully with 'unpack ok' in the response
The local clone at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ contains the new commits
The workspace database row head_sha equals the SHA of the new HEAD commit
No git push to the upstream remote is performed

smoke_tests.description: Unauthenticated git clone is rejected with HTTP 401 and a Basic auth challenge, prompting the git client for credentials.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `git clone http://<hub-host>:<port>/git/<org-slug>/<workspace-slug>.git` without any credentials against a running hub instance
real_components: Echo HTTP server with git routes registered via MountHandlers
git auth middleware (missing Authorization header detection)
git client (git binary)
expected_effects: Response includes header WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="af-hub"
git client prompts for credentials or reports authentication failure if running non-interactively
No repository data is returned to the client

smoke_tests.description: A git push using a read-only PAT (git:read scope only) is rejected with HTTP 403 at the authorization middleware.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `git push` using a PAT with only git:read scope against a running hub instance
real_components: Echo HTTP server with git routes registered via MountHandlers
git auth middleware (credential resolution via apikit)
git authorization middleware (scope check for receive-pack)
git client (git binary)
mockable: SQLite database (workspace not queried for repository open)
expected_effects: No changes are made to the local clone at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
git client reports a permission error to the user
